## Running Code

Spin up the data and all needed libraries.

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
library(erikmisc)

aydens_data <- read_csv("./final_data.csv")
```

The "DEBT_ALL_STGP_ANY_MEAN" variable has lots of "PS" entries. I suspect this is a null value referring to (perhaps) that a main, or even related, campus reported this data. As recovering this is work for more detailed analysis, we're just going to toss these variables out for now, and understand that later work needs to cover these in detail.. We already have plenty to work with. The same is true for "NOT1STGEN_COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR2_RT" and "DEATH_YR8_RT". These may be more useful later on, but for EDA, they're bogging us down right now. We also remove the index row. As CONTROL.y is the same as CONTROL.x, we remove CONTROL.y. Similarly, while they may be useful later on, we throw out CITY and OPEID6 right now as well. We're also going to toss out "BBRR1_FED_UG_DFLT" for similar reasons, with the acknowledgement that we're going to come back to it later.

On the other hand, some of these do have "PS" entries, but they're far less common. So we can clean those up. Doing this tosses away roughly four thousand entries of our forty-five thousand entries. Not great in the long-term, but good enough for some initial EDA.

```{r}
daniels_data <- aydens_data |> select(-c(DEBT_ALL_STGP_ANY_MEAN, NOT1STGEN_COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR2_RT, `...1`, DEATH_YR8_RT, CONTROL.y, CITY, OPEID6, BBRR1_FED_UG_DFLT))
daniels_data <- daniels_data |> subset(FIRSTGEN_COMP_ORIG_YR2_RT != "PS")
daniels_data <- daniels_data |> subset(NOPELL_WDRAW_ORIG_YR8_RT != "PS")
daniels_data <- daniels_data |> subset(PELL_WDRAW_ORIG_YR8_RT != "PS")
daniels_data <- daniels_data |> subset(PELL_COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR8_RT  != "PS")
rm(aydens_data)
```

Now we reassign some variable types as needed.

```{r}
daniels_data$DISTANCE <- as.factor(daniels_data$DISTANCE)
daniels_data$CONTROL.x <- as.factor(daniels_data$CONTROL.x)
daniels_data$CREDDESC <- as.factor(daniels_data$CREDDESC)
daniels_data$FIRSTGEN_COMP_ORIG_YR2_RT <- as.double(daniels_data$FIRSTGEN_COMP_ORIG_YR2_RT)
daniels_data$NOPELL_WDRAW_ORIG_YR8_RT <- as.double(daniels_data$NOPELL_WDRAW_ORIG_YR8_RT)
daniels_data$PELL_WDRAW_ORIG_YR8_RT <- as.double(daniels_data$PELL_WDRAW_ORIG_YR8_RT)
daniels_data$PELL_COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR8_RT <- as.double(daniels_data$PELL_COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR8_RT)
daniels_data$COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR8_RT <- as.double(daniels_data$COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR8_RT)
daniels_data$SCH_DEG <- as.factor(daniels_data$SCH_DEG)
daniels_data$MAIN.x <- as.factor(daniels_data$MAIN.x)
daniels_data$PREDDEG <- as.factor(daniels_data$PREDDEG)
daniels_data$HIGHDEG <- as.factor(daniels_data$HIGHDEG)
daniels_data$REGION <- as.factor(daniels_data$REGION)
```

Now we can look at some scatterplots.g

```{r}
numerical_data <- daniels_data |> select(where(is.numeric))
cor_matrix <- cor(numerical_data)
#ggscatmat(numerical_data)
rm(numerical_data)
```

We now look at just those directly correlated with our target variable. We'll deal with multicolinearity later.

```{r}
print(cor_matrix[1,])
```

We can also just be super lazy, and construct a full model, with no interference (for now) and see what AIC and BIC select as important variables.

```{r}
full_model <- lm(EARN_MDN_4YR ~ ., data = daniels_data)
reduced_model <- step(full_model, direction="backward")
summary(reduced_model)
```

From here, we note that there are a few things that have a fairly negligible effect, especially given the total quantities we're working with. Even though AIC doesn't remove them, we will remove: OVERALL_YR2_N, TUITIONFEE, D150, UGDS. We should also do some work on the correlation matrix:

```{r}
cor_matrix <- round(cor_matrix, digits = 2)
threshold <- 0.9
indices <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > threshold & upper.tri(cor_matrix) & cor_matrix != 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
trimmed_cor <- tibble(
  var1 = rownames(cor_matrix)[indices[,1]],
  var2 = rownames(cor_matrix)[indices[,2]],
  correlation = cor_matrix[indices]
)
rm(indices)
rm(threshold)
glimpse(trimmed_cor)
```

So we get rid of COSTT4_A, UG25ABV, C150_4_WHITE (maybe keep C150 and a C150 - C150 white, and do away with all other C150s), and all the pell grant variants of the listed variables: we keep COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR8_RT over ELL_COMP_4YR_TRANS_YR8_RT, and so forth.

```{r}
cor(daniels_data$C150_4, daniels_data$C150_4_WHITE)
summary(lm(C150_4 ~ C150_4_WHITE, data = daniels_data))
cor(daniels_data$COSTT4_A, daniels_data$TUITIONFEE_IN)
summary(lm(TUITIONFEE_IN ~ COSTT4_A, data = daniels_data))
```
